name: storelens
description: MCP connector for Storelens: detect Shopify themes and apps, spy on store catalogs, launches and live ads, and build Shopify store lead lists.
long_description: Detect any store's Shopify theme, apps and tech stack, open store spy reports with catalog, prices, launches and best sellers, see the Meta ads a store runs, track competitors for daily price and launch alerts, and search an index of live Shopify stores by theme, app, country and niche, with owner contacts. detect_store, search_leads, get_lead_filters, list_tracked_stores and get_alerts use no allowance; get_store_report, get_store_ads and reveal_store_contacts use the plan's monthly allowance, exactly as in the dashboard.
